We start with a conversation: when did it begin, under what conditions, what had been changed before. Some diagnoses are made here: ‘knocking only when cold’ and ‘knocking all the time’ indicate different components.

Then we scan all the systems at once: often, an error in ABS or comfort system explains the driver’s complaint. Next is a check on the car: lift, play, load inspection, and if necessary, pressure measurements and oscilloscope tests.

Finally, we show you the cause on the car and explain it clearly. If repairs are necessary, we quote the estimate right away.

How much does it cost: error reading is free. Paid diagnostics start only when we need to dismantle a component or put the car on a stand, and we provide the price before we start the work, not afterwards.

**BMW 116d u našem servisu u Beogradu.**

Ovoga puta nam je stigao BMW 116d koji je zahtevao sveobuhvatno tehničko održavanje i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova. Kod BMW-a je važno razumeti specifičnosti motora i pažljivo posmatrati svaki detalj: ne menjamo samo delove, već tražimo uzrok zbog kojeg dolazi do njihovog kvara.

**Koje smo poslove obavili na BMW 116d?**

1. **Zamena antifriza.** Izvršena je zamena rashladne tečnosti kako bi se obezbedila pravilna funkcija sistema za hlađenje motora. Pravovremena zamena antifriza pomaže u zaštiti elemenata sistema od korozije, održava optimalnu temperaturu i sprečava pregrevanje motora.
2. **Podmazivanje potporne ventila EGR u izduvnom sistemu.** Obavili smo uslugu potporne ventila sistema recirkulacije ispušnih gasova, koji se nalazi u izduvnoj cevi. Ovaj element učestvuje u regulisanju suprotnog pritiska ispušnih gasova i radu EGR sistema na dizel motorima BMW. Vremenom se mehanizam može zaprljati, zaglaviti i raditi nepravilno. Izvršili smo neophodno podmazivanje mehanizma ventila.
3. **Zamena nosača motora.** Zamenjen je istrošeni nosač motora BMW 116d. Nosači motora su odgovorni za fiksaciju agregata i smanjenje prenosa vibracija na karoseriju vozila. Njihovo trošenje može dovesti do pojačanih vibracija, neprijatnosti u kabini i dodatnih opterećenja na druge elemente.
4. **Utvrđena potreba za zamenom dempfera obrtnih oscilacija.** Tokom održavanja je takođe ustanovljeno da će automobilu biti potrebna dalja zamena dempfera obrtnih oscilacija radnog vratila. Ovaj element pomaže u ublažavanju oscilacija i obezbeđuje stabilan rad remenskog pogona dodatne opreme. Odlaganje zamene istrošenog dempfera se ne preporučuje, jer njegovo uništenje može dovesti do dodatnih kvarova i skupog popravka.
src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.f2dc489ea00d07c0:
**BMW 116d at our car service in Belgrade.**

This time, a BMW 116d came to us that needed comprehensive maintenance and the resolution of several issues. It is crucial to understand the characteristics of the engines and to examine every detail closely with BMW: we do not just replace parts but seek the root cause of why they fail.

**What work did we perform on the BMW 116d?**

1. **Coolant replacement.** We replaced the coolant to ensure the proper functioning of the engine's cooling system. Timely coolant changes help protect the system components from corrosion, maintain an optimal temperature range, and prevent engine overheating.
2. **Lubrication of the EGR valve in the exhaust system.** We serviced the EGR (Exhaust Gas Recirculation) valve located in the exhaust pipe. This component is involved in regulating back pressure of the exhaust gases and operates the EGR system in BMW diesel engines. Over time, the mechanism can become clogged, stick, and malfunction. We performed the necessary lubrication of the valve mechanism.
3. **Engine mount replacement.** We replaced the worn engine mount of the BMW 116d. Engine mounts are responsible for securing the powertrain and reducing vibrations transmitted to the vehicle's body. Their wear can lead to increased vibrations, discomfort in the cabin, and added strain on other components.
4. **Identified the need to replace the torsional vibration damper.** During the maintenance, we also determined that the vehicle would require a further replacement of the crankshaft torsional vibration damper. This component helps dampen vibrations and ensures stable operation of the accessory drive belt system. It is not advisable to postpone the replacement of a worn damper, as its failure can lead to additional malfunctions and costly repairs.

Audi A3 sa benzinskim **1.5 TFSI od 150 KS** i robotizovanom transmisijom DQ200 došao je u naš ruski autoservis u Beogradu na veliki servis. Zamenjen je zupčasti remen GPR.

Na osnovu dijagnostike zamenjena je i električna pumpa sistema hlađenja. To je poseban deo, i njena zamena nije povezana s velikim servisom ili remenom GPR. Dijagnostika je pokazala da je pumpa izgubila kapacitet i više ne cirkuliše rashladnu tečnost kako treba, a nismo hteli da čekamo da to uoči na temperaturi motora. Novi antifriz je natočen posle rada.

Paralelno je izveden i mali servis: motorno ulje i svi potrebni filteri.

Što se tiče menjača. DQ200 je robot sa suvim spojkama, i njemu je zamenjeno ulje u mehaničkom delu i radna tečnost u mehatronici. Preporuka za ovaj menjač je jednostavna: ulje i mehatroniku treba servisirati najmanje jednom na **60 000 km**. Na takvom intervalu uređaj duže traje i ređe se dolazi na skupi popravak.

src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.4dccab412605a2cb:
An Audi A3 with a gasoline **1.5 TFSI engine rated at 150 hp** and a DQ200 dual-clutch transmission arrived at our Russian car service in Belgrade for a major service. We replaced the timing belt.

Following the diagnostic check, we also replaced the electric cooling pump. This is a separate unit that is not directly related to the timing belt replacement during a major service. Diagnostics revealed that the pump had lost efficiency and was no longer circulating coolant properly, so we opted not to wait until this affected the engine's temperature regulation. We filled the system with fresh antifreeze after the work was completed.

In parallel, we performed a minor service: changing the engine oil and all necessary filters.

Next, onto the transmission. The DQ200 is a dual-clutch system with dry clutches, and we changed the oil in the mechanical section and the working fluid in the mechatronics. Our recommendation for this transmission is straightforward: both the oil and mechatronics should be serviced at least once every **60,000 km**. At this interval, the unit lasts longer and requires less frequent expensive repairs.

src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.f1c87824ae359949:
BMW 118d sa dizel motorom N47 i pređenih oko **380 000 km** stigao je u naš autoservis u Beogradu. Automobil je dovezen iz Danske, vlasnik ga je nedavno kupio i započeo sa kompletnim servisom i rešenjem problema koji su se već pojavili. Nakon kupovine, ovo je pravi redosled radnji.

Započeli smo sa kompletnim malim servisom: motorno ulje i svi filteri — uljni, vazdušni, kabinski i gorivni. Za N47, gorivni filter je posebna priča: stanje gorivne pumpe direktno utiče na rad motora i koliko će trajati njeni delovi.

Zatim su došle na red kočnice i ovjes. Zamenili smo elastične manžete, kočione diskove i pločice. Na polovnom automobilu sa velikim pređenim km, kočnice se prvo proveravaju, a ovde su istrošene morale biti zamenjene da bi se moglo mirno voziti dalje.

Pronašli smo curenje na zadnjem diferencijalu, zamenili smo semering i zaustavili gubitak podmazivanja. Kod automobila sa ovakvim pređenim km, diferencijal, brtvila i ostala prenosna mehanika zahtevaju posebnu pažnju.

Na 380 000 km lista radova jednim posetom se ne zatvara. Automobil ćemo dovoditi u red postepeno: kompletna dijagnostika, prioriteti, a zatim redosledom motor, kočioni sistem, ovjes i prenos. Upravo ovako savetujemo postupanje nakon kupovine polovnog automobila.

Dizeli N47 su poznati našim majstorima. Uz pravilno održavanje, ovakav pređeni km za motor nije presuda, ali nije dozvoljeno odlagati nalaze i preskočiti intervale.
src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.fc179656328ad80b:
A BMW 118d with an N47 diesel engine and around **380,000 km** on the clock arrived at our car service in Belgrade. The vehicle was brought in from Denmark; the owner recently purchased it and began with a comprehensive service to address any immediate issues. This is the right course of action after buying a used car.

We started with a full minor service: motor oil and all filters - oil, air, cabin, and fuel filters. For the N47, the fuel filter is a separate concern; the condition of the fuel system directly impacts how smoothly the engine runs and how long its components will last.

Next, we focused on the suspension and brakes. We replaced the flexible gaiters, brake discs, and pads. On a high-mileage used car, brakes are checked first, and here the worn components needed replacement to ensure the vehicle could be driven safely.

We discovered a leak from the rear differential, replaced the seal, and stopped the loss of lubricant. For cars with such mileage, the differential, seals, and the rest of the transmission require special attention.

At 380,000 km, the list of required work cannot be completed in one visit. We will gradually bring the car up to standard: a full diagnostic, establishing priorities, and then addressing the engine, brake system, suspension, and transmission in order. This is exactly how we recommend proceeding after purchasing a used vehicle.

Our technicians are familiar with the N47 diesel engines. With proper maintenance, this mileage isn’t a death sentence for the engine, but it’s crucial to address any identified issues promptly and not skip service intervals.

Danas smo u našem autservisu u Beogradu obavili servis za BMW X3. Ovo je već drugo malo održavanje koje radimo na ovom automobilu.

Ovog puta je klijent, osim obične zamene ulja i filtera, tražio da se zameni i ulje u 8-stepenom automatskom menjaču **ZF**.

Kod ovog menjača menjamo ulje zajedno sa posudom: filter je ugrađen u posudu, i proizvodi habanja s nečistoćama se nakupljaju baš tamo. Zamena samo ulja ne može se smatrati punim servisom za ovakav automatski menjač.

U motor smo sipali ulje sa odobrenjem **BMW Longlife-04** (BMW LL-04). Odobrenje za BMW je od ključnog značaja.

Pogledali smo i vijčane lopatice u usisu. Za sada nema kritičnih problema, ali smo klijentu rekli da ih na sledećem malom servisu treba skinuti i očistiti.

Honda Accord sa benzinskim motorom došao je u naš servis u Beogradu na redovno tehničko održavanje.

Zamenujemo motorno ulje i osnovne filtre: vazdušni, uljni i filter kabine. Stavljamo nove svećice - od njih zavisi kako motor glatko radi, kako se pali i koliko troši.

Dodatno smo zamenili antifriz i kočionu tečnost: od njih zavisi radna temperatura motora i pouzdanost kočnica.

### Koliko često menjati ulje u Honda Accord?

Za benzinski Accord preporučujemo interval od otprilike **7 500 km**. Ulje postepeno gubi svoja svojstva, a na takvom intervalu motor dobija sveže ulje pre nego što staro prestane da funkcioniše kako treba.

Pored ulja, tokom servisiranja ima smisla obratiti pažnju na filtre, svećice, antifriz, kočionu tečnost i ostali potrošni materijal.

A Honda Accord with a gasoline engine came to our car service in Belgrade for its routine maintenance.

We replaced the engine oil and the main filters: air, oil, and cabin. New spark plugs were installed as well, which are crucial for ensuring the smooth operation of the gasoline engine, its starting, and fuel efficiency.

Additionally, we replaced the coolant and brake fluid, both of which are vital for the engine's operating temperature and the reliability of the brakes.

### How often should you change the oil in a Honda Accord?

For the gasoline Accord, we recommend an interval of approximately **7,500 km**. Oil gradually loses its properties, and at this interval, the engine gets fresh oil before the old oil stops performing effectively.

In addition to oil changes, it's important to check the filters, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid, and other consumables during the maintenance.

**Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech. Major Service, Minor Service, and Transmission Oil Change in Belgrade**\
A Peugeot 208 with a 1.2 PureTech gasoline engine came to our service center in Zvezdara. The vehicle required comprehensive maintenance, so we performed a major service (veliki servis), a minor service (mali servis), and a transmission oil change.\
As part of the major service, we replaced the timing belt and necessary components, as well as the water pump. The 1.2 PureTech engine does not have the pump driven by the timing belt, but we recommend replacing it during the major service. If you decide to keep the old pump, we strongly advise replacing at least the small belt that drives it.\
It is essential to pay special attention to the timing belt replacement intervals for the 1.2 PureTech engines. Considering the updated recommendations and specific features of these engines, we recommend performing the major service every 60,000 km, without waiting for issues with the belt to arise. The exact schedule should be checked for the specific engine modification.\
Our service center is fully equipped with the necessary specialized tools for correctly conducting major services on Peugeot and Citroën 1.2 PureTech engines. All work is performed in accordance with the technology for setting and securing the timing phases.\
Additionally, we conducted a minor service with an oil and filter change, and we completely replaced the transmission oil using Valvoline oil.
src/content/works/peugeot-208-veliki-ser.d3507f5577c02e0c:
**Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech. Veliki servis, mali servis i zamena ulja u menjaču u Beogradu**\
U našu autoservis na Zvezdari stigao je Peugeot 208 sa benzinskim motorom 1.2 PureTech. Automobilu je bilo potrebno sveobuhvatno tehničko održavanje, pa smo izvršili veliki servis, mali servis i zamenu ulja u menjaču.\
U okviru velikog servisa zamenili smo razvodni remen i potrebne komponente, kao i vodenu pumpu. Na motoru 1.2 PureTech pumpa nije pokretana razvodnim remenom, ali preporučujemo da je menjate tokom velikog servisa. Ako ste se odlučili da zadržite staru pumpu, obavezno preporučujemo da zamenite barem jedan mali remen koji je pokreće.\
Posebnu pažnju treba obratiti na učestalost zamene razvodnog remena na motorima 1.2 PureTech. Imajući u vidu ažurirane preporuke i karakteristike ovih motora, preporučujemo veliki servis svake 60.000 km, ne čekajući da se pojave problemi sa remenom. Tačan režim održavanja treba proveriti prema konkretnoj modifikaciji motora.\
Naš autoservis ima sav potrebni specijalizovan alat za ispravno izvođenje velikog servisa na motorima Peugeot i Citroën 1.2 PureTech. Svi radovi se obavljaju uz poštovanje tehnologije ugradnje i fiksacije faza razdeljenja.\

Volkswagen Golf 2017. godište sa 7-stepenom robotizovanom transmisijom **DSG DQ381** došao je u naš auto servis u Beogradu na sveobuhvatan tehnički pregled i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova.

Tokom servisa zamenjena je poklopac ventila zbog curenja ulja, zaptiveni su sistem ubrizgavanja goriva, obavljeno je malo održavanje motora, zamenjeno je ulje i filter u DSG menjaču, a takođe su očišćeni kočioni čeljusti.

Posebna pažnja posvećena je DSG DQ381 menjaču. Ovo je moderna 7-stepena transmisija sa dva kvačila, za koju je važno pravovremeno menjati ulje i filtere: s vremenom ulje gubi svoja svojstva, akumuliraju se produkti habanja, što utiče na rad mehatronike, hidrauličkog sistema i kvačila. Redovno menjanje ulja održava glatko prebacivanje brzina i smanjuje rizik od skupog popravka DSG.

Za menjač je točeno posebno transmisiono ulje **MOTUL** potrebne specifikacije, a i u motor je točeno MOTUL. Kvalitet motornog i transmisionog ulja direktno utiče na to koliko dugo će automobil trajati.

U okviru malog održavanja zamenjeno je motorno ulje i neophodni filteri: za turbo motore Volkswagen pravovremena zamena ulja je posebno važna, jer podmazuje delove, odvodi toplotu i štiti turbinua od preuranjenog habanja.

Poklopac ventila je zamenjen jer je stari počeo da propušta ulje: takva curenja s vremenom se pojačavaju i dovode do zagađenja motora. Takođe su zaptivene mlaznice goriva: hermetičnost spojeva je važna za sigurnu funkcionalnost gorivnog sistema.

Očišćeni su i kočioni čeljusti od prljavštine i korozije: zapečeni pokretni elementi uzrokuju neujednačeno habanje kočionih pločica, pregrevanje diskova i strana zvuk prilikom kočenja.

A 2017 Volkswagen Golf with a 7-speed DSG transmission came to our car service in Belgrade for a comprehensive maintenance check and to address several issues.

During the service, we replaced the valve cover due to an oil leak, resealed the fuel injectors, performed a minor engine service, changed the oil and filter in the DSG transmission, and cleaned the brake calipers.

Particular attention was given to the DSG DQ381 transmission. This modern 7-speed dual-clutch transmission requires timely oil and filter changes: over time, the oil loses its properties, and wear products accumulate, which negatively impacts the mechatronics, hydraulic system, and clutches. Regular oil changes ensure smooth gear shifting and reduce the risk of costly DSG repairs.

We filled the transmission with the appropriate **MOTUL** transmission fluid, and the engine was also filled with MOTUL oil. The quality of the engine and transmission oil directly affects how long a vehicle will last.

As part of the minor service, we replaced the engine oil and necessary filters. Timely oil changes are especially important for turbocharged Volkswagen engines as they lubricate the parts, dissipate heat, and protect the turbocharger from premature wear.

The valve cover was replaced because the old one began to leak oil: such leaks worsen over time and lead to engine contamination. We also resealed the fuel injectors since the integrity of the connections is crucial for the safe operation of the fuel system.

We cleaned the brake calipers of dirt and corrosion: stuck moving parts can cause uneven pad wear, overheating of the discs, and unusual sounds during braking.

src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.08f6c6c56c6b7bcf:
Zamena ulja u **DSG DQ381** je deo održavanja menjača koji je najbolje ne zanemariti.

Ovaj put smo radili redovnu zamenu: klijent je izabrao ulje **MEYLE**, sipali smo ga i obavili ostalo potrebno održavanje.

DQ381 je savremeni sedmostepeni robot DSG sa mokrim spojnicama, koji se koristi u mnogim Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda i SEAT vozilima. Ako se održava na vreme, ovakav menjač traje dugo i bez ozbiljnih problema.

Sa drugim popularnim DSG menjačima, DQ250 i DQ200, situacija je slična. Njihova konstrukcija i propisi se razlikuju, ali stanje ulja i pravovremeno održavanje direktno utiču na trajnost menjača, rad mehatronike i spojnica.

Preporučujemo da se orijentišete ne samo na formalne propise već i na stvarne uslove korišćenja. Ako vam istorija održavanja nije poznata, sigurno nije preporučljivo koristiti isto ulje duže od 100–150 hiljada kilometara. Nakon **100 000 km** ima smisla saznati kada i kako je menjač održavan, a za DQ381 i DQ250 ulje obično treba menjati znatno ranije.

Sveže kvalitetno ulje zadržava potrebna svojstva pri različitim temperaturama i opterećenjima, podmazuje i odvodi toplotu. Zbog toga skupi popravci se odlažu.

Kupili ste polovni automobil i ne znate kada je poslednji put održavan DSG DQ381, DQ250 ili DQ200 — proverite stanje menjača i njegovu istoriju unapred.

Changing the oil in the **DSG DQ381** is an essential part of maintaining the gearbox that should not be overlooked.

This time, we performed a scheduled oil change: the client chose **MEYLE** oil, which we filled and paired with the necessary additional maintenance.

The DQ381 is a modern seven-speed DSG gearbox with wet clutches, used in many Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda, and SEAT models. When serviced on time, this gearbox can last a long time without serious issues.

The same goes for other common DSG models, such as the DQ250 and DQ200. They have different designs and regulations, but the condition of the oil and timely servicing directly affect the lifespan of the gearbox, the performance of the mechatronics, and the clutches.

We recommend being guided not only by the formal regulations but also by real-world operating conditions. If the service history is unknown, running on the same oil for 100,000 to 150,000 kilometers is definitely not advisable. It makes sense to check when and how the gearbox was serviced at least once every **100,000 km**, and for the DQ381 and DQ250, changing the oil is usually advisable much earlier.

Fresh, quality oil retains the necessary properties under various temperatures and loads, providing lubrication and dissipating heat. This helps to postpone expensive repairs.

If you bought a used car and are unsure when the DSG DQ381, DQ250, or DQ200 was last serviced, check the condition of the gearbox and its history in advance.
